findings.claim: The new two-line comment explaining that the check now matches any version, canonical or zksync variant, with a migrate method duplicates what the isSafeMigrationCall docstring already states, and repo guidance treats code comments as tech debt to be minimized. It could be shortened back to the original one-line comment.

The layout fix from removing the wrapper div relies on a CSS selector (.step > .txCardRoot:first-child) matching correctly, but there is no test or story guarding this behavior, so a wrapper added later could silently reintroduce the layout gap without any warning.

It is unverified whether the Client Gateway returns trustedDelegateCallTarget: true for the 1.5.0 SafeMigration addresses; if it does not, isSafeUpdateTxData will still return false at the trusted-call check and the banner will not appear in production even with this fix, and the unit tests cannot catch this because they hard-code that flag to true.
